intro: Step back to 14,000 BC. You are at Direkli Cave, in Kahramanmaraş province, at the foot of the Taurus. At the end of the ice age, hunting groups made this cave a seasonal camp, and its excavation documents the time before farming.
history: At the foot of the Taurus, this cave served as a seasonal camp for hunting groups at the end of the ice age. Excavations since 2007 have documented how people ate and made their tools in Anatolia before farming. Among the finds are ornamental beads and bone tools, small objects that bring those hunters close.
highlights: As you wander, don't miss the Epipalaeolithic layers and the Bone tools. Then look for the Ornamental beads, and finish at the hearths.
facts: Did you know? The hearths show that people returned to the same spot and used it again over thousands of years. The cave was a seasonal camp for hunting groups at the end of the ice age.
outro: This brings our tour of Direkli Cave to an end. Please leave the stones untouched, keep to the marked paths and carry water with you. This cave has kept its secrets for ages; let it keep them for those who come after you. Enjoy your visit.
